title: "Sampling"

# Sampling

Sampling determines **who or what can enter the evidence** and how uncertainty should later be estimated.

## Probability sampling

Simple random sampling, systematic sampling, stratified sampling, cluster sampling, multistage sampling and probability proportional to size.

## Non-probability and hard-to-reach designs

Purposive sampling, convenience sampling, snowball sampling, respondent-driven sampling and time-location sampling.

## Sample-size pathways

LIPPS will provide separate guidance for prevalence estimation, means, two-group comparisons, cohort and case-control studies, diagnostic studies, cluster surveys, survival studies, regression and finite populations.
